PowerOneLineOne: Destroy one car-sized or smaller object that is not sentient and does not have
PowerOneLineTwo: hit points. If this requirements are ignored, this still does some damage
PowerOneLineThree: including 6HP of damaga if the target has hit-points.
PowerTwoLineOne: Create a large wall of ice. This can be used to force an end to fighting.
PowerTwoLineTwo: This can also be used as a reaction if you did not user your Tamer Action on
PowerTwoLineThree: your turn. It is a truck-length barrier with 30 hit-points.
PowerThreeLineOne: During the beginning of combat you or an ally of your choosing get to re-roll
PowerFourLineOne: For the current scene your Digimon gets a buff on all contact moves.
PowerFourLineTwo: They get an extra buff if the target is weak to Cold, Metal, Water or
PowerFiveLineOne: Yourself and any consenting allies are teleported to a random nearby
PowerFiveLineTwo: safe location. This can be used as a reaction if you haven't used your
PowerSixLineOne: One target with a Vibes Save below 14 instantly becomes friendly to you.
PowerSixLineTwo: This only lasts until you do something that would make them turn on
PowerSixLineThree: you again, or you remind them of a deeper reason for hating you.
PowerSevenLineOne: A Digimon of your choosing, for the rest of this scene, will enjoy
PowerSevenLineTwo: having all the effects of using its Gaurd, except the stat-regrowth
PowerEightLineOne: A sword appears in your hands that makes any hostile Digimon with
PowerEightLineTwo: a Wits save below 14 run away in fear.
